name: Can I make changes to the design once construction has started?

mainEntity.name: Can I make changes to the design once construction has started?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is always best to finalize all design decisions before construction begins, we understand that changes may occasionally be necessary. Any changes requested after construction starts are considered change orders. These will be formally documented, detailing the scope of work, potential impact on the project timeline, and any additional costs involved. We review all change orders with you for approval before proceeding to ensure transparency and minimize disruptions to the schedule and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design changes after construction starts are possible but documented as change orders, impacting timeline and cost. All changes require your approval.
